Drainage Pipe Laying Checklist 10 checkpoints across 4 sections.During drainage pipe laying Download ExcelDownload PDF **10** Checkpoints **4** Sections Per section QC Engineer [IS 458:2012](https://infralens.in/code/IS-458-Part-1-2003) Related [📐IS 458](https://infralens.in/code/IS-458) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Concrete Cover Requirements](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. PIPE QUALITY & PLACEMENT | | A1 | Drainage pipes are undamaged; no cracks, chips, or deformation visible
Acceptance: Pipes inspected, no visible defects, test certificate checked | Cl. 3.1 — Physical condition | | | A2 | Pipes laid on sand cushion with proper support; no direct contact with trench bottom
Acceptance: Sand cushion 100mm, pipe seats on sand, even bearing along length | Cl. 4.1 — Support | | | A3 | Pipe alignment checked - alignment straight along the line per design
Acceptance: Alignment verified with string line, no lateral deviation >25mm per 100m | Cl. 4.2 — Alignment | | | B. JOINTING & CONNECTIONS | | B1 | Spigot fully inserted into socket with minimum 1/3 pipe diameter overlap (typically 100-150mm)
Acceptance: Spigot inserted minimum 100mm, socket rim visible around spigot, tight fit | Cl. 5.1 — Joint depth | | | B2 | Mortar joint applied (1:2 cement:sand) at socket interface; filled completely around circumference
Acceptance: Mortar filled 100% around joint, cured 48 hours before backfill, joint strength verified | Cl. 5.2 — Mortar joint | | | B3 | Joint is tested for water flow (if required for gravity lines) - no seepage observed
Acceptance: Visual inspection shows no water seeping from joint interface | Cl. 5.3 — Leakage test | | | C. GRADIENT & INVERT LEVEL | | C1 | Gradient (slope) verified as per design (typical 0.3-2.0% for gravity drainage)
Acceptance: Measured slope within design ±5%, documented at inlets/outlets/midpoints | Cl. 6.1 — Gradient | | | C2 | Invert levels at each pipe junction checked for proper drop/transition
Acceptance: Invert level allows gravity flow, drops at junctions reasonable (>50mm preferred) | Cl. 6.2 — Invert level | | Showing 8 of 10 checkpoints ·View all → A. PIPE QUALITY & PLACEMENT A1Drainage pipes are undamaged; no cracks, chips, or deformation visible Cl. 3.1 — Physical condition (IS 458) ✓ Pipes inspected, no visible defects, test certificate checked A2Pipes laid on sand cushion with proper support; no direct contact with trench bottom Cl. 4.1 — Support (IS 458) ✓ Sand cushion 100mm, pipe seats on sand, even bearing along length A3Pipe alignment checked - alignment straight along the line per design Cl. 4.2 — Alignment (IS 458) ✓ Alignment verified with string line, no lateral deviation >25mm per 100m B. JOINTING & CONNECTIONS B1Spigot fully inserted into socket with minimum 1/3 pipe diameter overlap (typically 100-150mm) Cl. 5.1 — Joint depth (IS 458) ✓ Spigot inserted minimum 100mm, socket rim visible around spigot, tight fit B2Mortar joint applied (1:2 cement:sand) at socket interface; filled completely around circumference Cl. 5.2 — Mortar joint (IS 458) ✓ Mortar filled 100% around joint, cured 48 hours before backfill, joint strength verified B3Joint is tested for water flow (if required for gravity lines) - no seepage observed Cl. 5.3 — Leakage test (IS 458) ✓ Visual inspection shows no water seeping from joint interface C. GRADIENT & INVERT LEVEL C1Gradient (slope) verified as per design (typical 0.3-2.0% for gravity drainage) Cl. 6.1 — Gradient (IS 458) ✓ Measured slope within design ±5%, documented at inlets/outlets/midpoints C2Invert levels at each pipe junction checked for proper drop/transition Cl. 6.2 — Invert level (IS 458) ✓ Invert level allows gravity flow, drops at junctions reasonable (>50mm preferred) Showing 8 of 10 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS REJECTED — REWORK Inspected By Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
